# Duskfall Survivors

> Original 16-bit pixel-art horde survival roguelite, playable free in any modern browser. No download, no account, no ads, no tracking. Works offline after first load (PWA + service worker).

## Key facts
- Genre: single-player horde survival roguelite (auto-firing weapons, 15-minute stages, endless mode after clear)
- Platform: static web export (Canvas 2D, Next.js), desktop keyboard + touch joystick; deployable to any static host
- Languages: English, 简体中文, 日本語, Español (in-game language switcher, localized marketing pages with hreflang)
- Price: free, no in-app purchases
- Art/audio: 100% original in-code pixel sprites and Web Audio synthesized music/SFX; no third-party game assets
- Data: all save data stays in the browser's localStorage; nothing is uploaded

## Game systems
- 8 weapons × 8 ranks, each with a final evolution unlocked at max rank plus its paired relic
- 10 passive relics, 3-card level-up draft with 2 rerolls and skip-for-XP
- 4 playable survivors (2 unlockable with in-run coins), 3 stages with distinct palettes, weather and enemy rosters
- 4 enemy AI archetypes: ranged caster, telegraphed charger, fuse exploder, splitter
- Bosses at 05:00 / 10:00 / 14:00 with an enrage phase at half health (summons + radial bullet hell)
- Dynamic night lighting, weather particles, achievements, bestiary and stage records
- Single-hit mercy cap: no strike removes more than 45% of max HP
